name: Multimodal Coreference Resolution for Chinese Social Media Dialogues
description: A dataset and benchmark for resolving coreference across text and images in Chinese social media dialogues.
evaluation_method: Coreference F1 (e.g., averaged MUC / B³ / CEAF or overall mention/coref F1)
reputation: New ACL 2025 contribution targeting multimodal coreference in Chinese social-media dialogs; of interest to multimodal and dialogue researchers but not yet widely adopted.
notes: Multimodal (text+image) dataset with noisy social-media content; annotation and evaluation vary by metric (MUC/B³/CEAF); potential privacy/consent concerns for social-media data; not an LLM-centric benchmark.
